sofia: quick heads-up — planning a quarterly least-priv sweep in staging next Tue 10:00 PT. aiming to validate owner attribution heuristics, exercise KMS re-grant flow, and confirm audit-log fidelity before prod cutover.
ben: +1. can you call out the owner heuristics so we don't accidentally drop service-admins?
sofia: sure — heuristics summary: prefer owner tag > ticket assignee > last-activity within 180d. exemptions: svc accounts with 'svc-exempt' tag or keys with cross-account grantees. any ambiguous hits go to review queue.
nadeem: For KMS, are we doing revoke/create or rotate? We should avoid rotate for keys used by lambda warmers.
sofia: revoke/create for grants only (no key material rotate). test steps in staging: revoke grant -> observe CloudTrail + audit-proxy -> create-grant -> verify traffic. commands:
```
aws kms revoke-grant --key-id alias/stg-data-key --grant-id 5f6e7d8c
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/stg-data-key --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/stg-proc --operations Encrypt Decrypt
```
audit-bot: snapshot generated: snap-qps-20260328-1000. artifact: s3://sec-dryruns/snap-4198765432.tar.gz
ben: nice. can we also grep for kms:RetireGrant in case some automation uses that?
sofia: good call — we'll check CreateGrant, RevokeGrant, RetireGrant in CloudTrail playback. also excluding keys with external account grantees.
nadeem: what's the abort criteria for the canary?
sofia: abort if >0.5% token refresh errors for any service, or if audit-playback finds an event gap >1s for grant ops, or if more than one service sees persistent 401s after 5m.
ops-bot: starting preflight export: export-id ex-4198765432. checksum: sha256:7e240de74fb1ed08fa08d38063f6a6a9
sofia: running canary on these services: auth-api, ingest-worker, billing-collector. i'll post diffs and audit-proxy traces after each step. please react with :eyes: if watching.
ben: :eyes: watching auth-api traces
nadeem: watching KMS logs and lambda error rates
audit-bot: playback window captured: 2026-03-28T10:00:00Z -> 2026-03-28T10:12:00Z. no gaps detected in primary stream.
sofia: canary results: auth-api had two transient 401s during revoke window, both resolved after grant recreation and a one-line restart. ingest-worker unaffected. audit-proxy and CloudTrail show matching RevokeGrant/CreateGrant events for the test key.
ben: handoff required: please draft a short blameless FYI for support and set a quick RFC for staggered prod rollout (15m windows).
sofia: will do. i'll tag RFC-SEC-2026 and add the rollback playbook link: https://confluence.redwood/sec/entitlement-rollback. thanks all.
